lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: Hello, Clover? Are you there?|I don't think here is here David.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Its fine. Just leave a message for them.|They will pick up the phone at some point

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: It has been a while since you have left Tiltan.|I still fondly remember our clash, how you still showed mercy to me.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: I remember that too. I was surprised.|When you first arrived in my class, I still felt something pure in you.|You really wanted to study, even if the subject was hard.|You didn't give up, even if I threw everything at you.

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: But its weird....|Why out of all of the teachers in Tiltan, Yakir was the only one you decided to not show mercy towards?|What was the main reason behind this course of action?

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: This is actually still being investigated by the Tiltan authorities.|I don't know the answer to that question either.|In fact, no one actually does. There was no sign of intentional killing...|Or any clue as to why would you do it....|But we would like to think of one reason.|You find Yakir to just not be likeable for some reason.

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: Yakir was a good soul. I had to take his place as the C# teacher for a few years.|I actually liked it a bit more than being the Game Design teacher.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: I think Yakir was a good teacher too.|He was a bit strict, but he was fair and honest.|He was also very passionate about his subject, and he really wanted to teach it to everyone.|He always saw the good in other students even if they were reckless.

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: Which is still weird... Why would Clover do this?|We may never know.|But I do know one thing. And if you ever step foot in this college again

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: You won't come out of it alive. That is a promise
